items.title: Listen to D’Angelo’s Posthumous Song “Kamikazi”
items.summary:
An unreleased D'Angelo song called "Kamikazi" has arrived on streaming services, weeks after players first heard it buried in the radio dial of Grand Theft Auto VI. The track turned up on Worldwide FM, one of the in-game stations in Rockstar Games' new release, and listeners who thought they recognized that voice were right.

Pitchfork reported the song's release to streaming, noting that it was one of a long list of new recordings and unexpected cameos stashed throughout the game, which arrived last week. GTA VI's radio stations have become their own discovery engine, with players combing the dial for material that exists nowhere else.

D'Angelo had worked with Rockstar before. He wrote "Unshaken" for Red Dead Redemption 2 in 2019, and later explained that he was a "massive, massive, massive fan" of the series, reached out to the studio himself, and spent hours at Rockstar's New York offices playing the game.

The singer died of cancer in October 2025. His early run — 1995's Brown Sugar and 2000's Voodoo — made him one of the defining figures in R&B, after which he withdrawn almost entirely from public life until Black Messiah, credited to D'Angelo and the Vanguard, arrived in 2014 alongside a few widely circulated television performances.

His appearances after that were scattered and mostly as a guest: "IBTIHAJ" with GZA and Rapsody in 2019, Slingbaum's "Behoove" with Erykah Badu in early 2020, and "I Want You Forever" with Jay-Z, written by Jeymes Samuel for the 2024 film The Book of Clarence. "Kamikazi" now joins that short list, this time as a lead credit.

items.title: ‘Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album’ Deluxe Adds 23 Original Songs From Travis Scott, Slayyyter, Offset, Sexyy Red and More
items.summary:
Atlantic Records and Rockstar Games released a deluxe edition of Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album without warning, adding 23 original songs to a soundtrack that already ran 34 tracks. The expansion includes new material from Travis Scott, 21 Savage, Slayyyter, Offset, Latto, Sexyy Red, Anitta, Denzel Curry, Kodak Black, Pooh Shiesty, Young Nudy, the Dare, Health, Power Trip, Chris Stassy and Overmono, who contributed five tracks on his own.

Variety reported the deluxe edition's arrival, which follows the original album's November 20 release alongside the game itself. That first set carried new songs from Justice, Playboi Carti, Dua Lipa, Cardi B, Jennie, Tove Lo, Lana Del Rey and Kali Uchis, among others.

Rockstar marked the game's launch with Grand Theft Auto VI: The Festival, held Saturday at Mana Wynwood in Miami. Travis Scott, Cardi B, Metro Boomin and Justice all performed, drawing from artists featured in the game.

The two albums are only part of the music attached to GTA VI. Justice scored the game, players have identified nearly 750 individual tracks within it, and 20 in-game radio stations carry hosts including Robyn, Trick Daddy, JT, Lindsey Buckingham, Buddy Guy and Keith Richards.

Among the deluxe additions are Travis Scott's "Burn This Shit Down," Slayyyter's "internet $tar," Offset's "I Just Came To Pop It," 21 Savage's "Quavo Cookin," Latto's "50 Bands" featuring Flo Milli, and a Sexyy Red remix of Real Dimez's "Cooties." Both tracklists are now available alongside the game, which remains the largest music commission Rockstar has assembled.

items.title: Super Bowl 2027 and Jay-Z Halftime Show to Screen in Imax Theaters
items.summary:
Imax will screen the Super Bowl in its theaters for the first time, partnering with ESPN, the Walt Disney Company and the NFL on a four-hour presentation of Super Bowl LXI. The broadcast will play in hundreds of Imax venues across the United States and in select international markets, making it the largest live event the company has staged.

Super Bowl LXI takes place February 14 at SoFi Stadium in Inglewood. The theatrical presentation will carry ESPN's main game telecast along with pregame and postgame coverage and the halftime show headlined by Jay-Z. Variety reported that tickets are expected to go on sale in January, with participating locations and ticketing details to follow in the coming weeks.

Imax plans to run a promotional spot and other marketing materials in theaters during Thanksgiving week. The company has been expanding into live and alternative programming, including recent screenings tied to the FIA Formula One World Championship.

Ken Potrock, the Walt Disney Company's president of major event integration, framed the deal around the communal side of the game. "Watching the Super Bowl with your fellow fans is one of the great shared experiences in sports, and this first-of-its-kind collaboration with the NFL and Imax takes it to a historic new scale," he said, adding that ESPN's first Super Bowl is reaching fans "across an unprecedented range of platforms."

Imax CEO Rich Gelfond called the arrangement a milestone for the company and a further elevation of its standing as a global platform for entertainment and events. "The Super Bowl is a one-of-a-kind global cultural event imbued with spectacle, sound, drama, and heroes — all the makings of a great Imax experience," he said.

The game marks ESPN's first Super Bowl broadcast, and the Imax screenings give Disney another distribution route for it. Specific theater lists and on-sale dates have not yet been set.
